results.title: Melaka polls: Wawasan eyeing Bemban, Sungai Udang seats, says Saifuddin
results.description: MELAKA: Parti Wawasan Negara (Wawasan) aims to contest at least the Bemban and Sungai Udang state seats in the upcoming Melaka polls, as it continues seat-sharing negotiations with its allies, says Datuk Seri Saifuddin Abdullah.
